title: Source carrier is captured after detector-grid interpolation
evidence: reduction_observation_inputs.h:71-94 captures only after load_and_point; todproc_alignment_impl.h:139-143,256-257 and timestream_alignment_helpers.h:365-387 replace telescope columns and TelTime; timestream_alignment_state.h:21-24 declares pre-interpolation authority
impact: Motion gaps, boundaries, and v95 are bound to an interpolated detector grid rather than eligible source-telescope rows
required_closure: Bind reset/capture/consume to the frozen pre-interpolation source authority and demonstrate the approved lifecycle permutations

title: Supported total-intensity carrier preparation retains stale legacy HWPR dependence
evidence: todproc_alignment_impl.h:85-99,113-149,259-265 branches on calib.run_hwpr; hwpr_loading.h:16-34 leaves total-intensity state untouched; calib.h:40-41 has no declaration initializer; test_config_scaffold.cpp:7188-7196 preserves stale true state
impact: Supported diagnostics can depend on prohibited stale or uninitialized HWPR state; explicit unsupported_hwpr is also not dominant over every invalid prerequisite permutation
required_closure: Remove prohibited stale-HWPR dependence from the supported total-intensity route and deterministically enforce the frozen unsupported-HWPR seam

title: Counterfactual context is built from already RTC-downsampled PTC data and decimated again
evidence: rtcproc.h:1184-1245 applies realized downsampling; output call sites pass processed PTC; rtcproc.h:5491-5619 derives rows/flags/time from it and :5689-5719 applies every candidate factor again
impact: Factor 1 is already coarsened; M>1 is double-decimated; OR-reduced flags and FIR context cannot reproduce native counterfactual validity
required_closure: Evaluate every candidate on the exact native total-intensity domain with the realized filter/phase authority, without reconstructing it from coarsened output

title: Scan-boundary guards and complete category accounting are absent from the final exact context
evidence: rtcdiag_scan_summary.h:221-252 constructs guarded eligible rows but rtcproc.h:5554-5573 uses only unguarded interval lookup; input boundary is serialized as zero at rtcdiag_scan_summary.h:1108-1123; only category counts, not required fractions, exist; nonfinite time is classified as gap first
impact: Boundary, gap, and nonfinite exclusions can be misclassified and required complete accounting is unavailable or contradictory
required_closure: Consume the frozen guarded source-row mask, preserve category precedence, and serialize complete mutually exclusive counts and fractions

title: Preflight underbounds actual response work and omits material work/storage
evidence: rtc_learned_sampling_metrics.h:642-667 evaluates unaliased plus M images but :1113-1135 charges only M image terms; exact probe admits 360703607 while actual is 515005150 over the 500000000 limit; per-row linear interval lookup, category storage, nine source arrays, and raw-manifest bytes are uncharged
impact: The candidate can perform work or allocate/write storage above its declared hard limits and detect file size only after publication work
required_closure: Use overflow-safe guards that cover the exact invoked calculation, context construction, transient allocations, serialized auxiliary state, and manifest bytes before evaluation/publication

title: Executable successor contract accepts malformed conditional schemas and weak identity bindings
evidence: validate_product_contract.py:1015-1102 and rtcdiag_netcdf.h:205-218 check incomplete dimensional/cardinality relations; exact check returns no errors for an available 81-variable table collapsed to one dimension and for unavailable count 7 with no dimension; required cadence/filter/beam/support fields and FIR/manifest digest recomputation are absent
impact: Products can pass while contradicting writer shape, conditional count, exact rerun identity, and provenance requirements
required_closure: Make the executable mode contract enforce full scan/array/candidate shape, truthful unavailable count, complete compact state, and relational identity/digest bindings

title: Published contract/profile scalars do not identify the executable mode contract/profile
evidence: rtcdiag_netcdf.h:38-43,317-322 embeds nonexistent generic contract sci-rtc-001-stage-a-successor-products-v1 and point profile for all modes; actual wrappers/profiles are mode-specific at product_contracts.json:2811-2848 and validation_profiles.json:483-648
impact: OOF, Beammap, and science products claim the point profile and no registry contract matches the embedded contract ID
required_closure: Bind each product to its exact executable mode-specific successor contract and preparing validation profile

title: The joined object is not a canonical raw-input manifest
evidence: reduction_observation_pipeline.h:30-40 passes raw_timestream_provenance.yaml; raw_timestream_provenance.h:147-166 contains config/observation resolution but no raw membership, roles, paths, or hashes; finalizer accepts any nonempty bytes
impact: The required exact raw-input join and reproducible input identity are absent even when publication succeeds
required_closure: Join the successor product to the frozen canonical raw-input membership/identity bytes and validate the digest relationship

title: Failed rtcdiag publication can break the prior-good manifest join
evidence: raw_timestream_provenance_lifecycle.h:80-96 replaces a fixed sidecar before rtcdiag finalization; later provenance/validation/sync/close/publish failure preserves prior rtcdiag but not its prior sidecar; tests preserve only the NetCDF file
impact: A previously complete advertised generation can become internally inconsistent after a failed successor attempt
required_closure: Publish one self-contained file or a generation-specific set with one manifest/pointer committed last; cover the complete failure matrix and prior-good join

title: Lifecycle and observe-only evidence does not cross the production boundary
evidence: test_rtc_learned_sampling_metrics.cpp:325-339 reuses candidate transfer helper; :627-653 tests carrier helpers; :756-789 compares unrelated local science/RTC/PTC/map vectors; no B/A, failed/partial, repeated, or permitted-parallel production permutation exists
impact: Green tests cannot establish same-observation ownership, no stale context, numerical independence, or non-interference with production science
required_closure: Provide independent-oracle numerical checks and real production A/B, B/A, failure, repeat, and permitted-parallel lifecycle/non-interference evidence

title: Ordinary epoch-valued realized cadence is falsely rejected as irregular
evidence: rtcdiag_scan_summary.h:61-95 uses max(1e-9,64eps*median) on Unix epoch doubles; ideal 488 Hz grid at epoch 1.7e9 has representable step spread 2.384185791015625e-7 and the independent probe returns would_reject=True
impact: Normal observations can lose all dependent Stage A metrics as irregular_realized_cadence
required_closure: Derive cadence with a numerically sound epoch-aware method while preserving the frozen valid-realized-grid authority

title: Requested/effective/realized consistency statuses are not independent or safely reset
evidence: rtcdiag_scan_summary.h:61-117 calculates both statuses only after realized cadence succeeds and does not fully clear repeated-call fields; frequency-derived requests retain requested_factor<=0 and become unavailable_nonpositive
impact: A requested/effective mismatch can be hidden by an unrelated realized-cadence failure and valid frequency requests are mislabeled
required_closure: Compute and reset each provenance value/status independently, retaining every knowable mismatch without blocking truthful realized diagnostics

title: Full 40-hex source identity is a stale configure-time snapshot
evidence: CMakeLists.txt:67-96 captures commit/dirty only during configure with no Git ref/index/worktree build dependency; runtime validates those constants but ordinary rebuild can compile changed source under the old clean SHA
impact: A syntactically valid clean commit scalar need not identify the compiled source
required_closure: Make committed build/source identity refresh or fail for every ordinary build and validate it after write/reopen

title: Exact finite M_max is discarded above INT_MAX
evidence: rtc_sampling_candidate_mmax at rtc_learned_sampling_metrics.h:1042-1056 returns -1 for larger finite floors; rtcdiag_scan_summary.h:634-642 maps it to invalid_cadence; 8.48,1e10,1 yields -1 instead of 84800000000
impact: The exact physical candidate bound and truthful resource-limit status are lost on a valid finite input
required_closure: Retain exact M_max in a sufficient integer representation and report explicit resource-limit status without attempting or silently truncating enumeration

title: Production carrier consumption validates only obsnum
evidence: timestream_alignment_state.h:52-81 binds/checks observation index, obsnum, and telescope path; rtcdiag_output_impl.h:98-103 checks only availability and obsnum
impact: Different reduction-local observations or telescope sources sharing an external obsnum can consume stale context
required_closure: Validate the complete bound observation identity at the production consumer and cover mismatched index/path plus repeated/failure permutations
